thread:
jamie: Kicking off EU progressive rollout (5%) for inference-service v3.2.0 — change window started. Requesting quick stop/go from leads.
deploy-bot: Deploy job started: release-id=rls-2026-04-21-6891230000, target=eu/*, percentage=5%, variant=v3.2.0. Rolling out to 3 nodes.
maya: Hold — dashboard shows frontend 502 spike across eu-west-1 at ~T+2m. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/board/ab12cd34
sheraz: +1 hold. Error rate went 0.9% (baseline 0.12%). Logs show repeated `kvcache: allocate failed` on pod inference-eu-02. Snippet: "2026-04-21T10:04:22Z ERROR kvcache: oom during alloc size=5242880"
ops-oncall: I'm pulling pod logs and heap profiles now. If kvcache OOM, might be quantized kernel memory regression.
jamie: Can we do a regional pinback to previous stable (v3.1.9) while we investigate? We want to avoid global rollback if it's localized.
tim: I recommend pin EU traffic back to v3.1.9 and keep 5% traffic diverted until we confirm fix. That buys safety and fewer churns.
deploy-bot: Command received: `pin-version --region=eu --version=v3.1.9 --retain=100% --until=manual`
deploy-bot: Action: routing changes applied. EU traffic pinned to v3.1.9. Current rollout percentage for v3.2.0 in eu: 0%.
maya: Confirming metrics after pin: 502s dropping, error rate back to 0.15. Nice.
sheraz: Will continue to collect heapdumps from the failing nodes and compare kernel/quantization libs. Assigning to @sheraz for triage.
ops-oncall: Opening incident INC-1234 and attaching initial findings. Will keep EU pinned until remediation validated.
jamie: Consensus: HOLD for global rollout, EU pinned to v3.1.9, triage owner=sheraz, ops-oncall owns the incident. Plan: reproduce on a canary node with the same quantization build and push a patch or rollback kernel selection.
tim: Also recommend a quick sweep for other regions' canaries to ensure no silent regressions; schedule a 15m check-in.
jamie: Thanks everyone — canary halted, pin applied, incident opened. We'll reconvene at +15 for status. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Note: release rls-2026-04-21-6891230000 marked: paused, reason="metric spike - 502s", pinned_regions=["eu"], owner=ops-oncall."
